quarterly_data.signal: 10-K supplier disclosure: MaxLinear is fabless and uses process technology nodes from 0.25µ down to 4 nanometer (standard CMOS to SiGe and GaAs). Its key foundry partners are Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation (TSMC) in Taiwan and United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC) in Taiwan and Singapore; a large portion of its products are manufactured by TSMC and UMC, and it has no long-term supply contracts with most of its vendors, including TSMC and UMC, buying substantially all on a purchase order basis. Certain products are supplied by Intel Corporation on a turnkey basis, and the majority of its assembly/packaging and test is done by Advanced Semiconductor Engineering (ASE), Greatek Electronics, Signetics Corporation, SIGURD Microelectronics and Silicon Precision Industries. It gives foundry and assembly/test contractors production forecasts six to twelve months in advance, places firm orders up to twenty-six weeks before delivery, and had inventory purchase obligations of $168,484 thousand as of December 31, 2025 ($117,910 thousand due in 2026 and $50,574 thousand in 2027).
